domains.label: Surface
domains.description: 3D and 2D geometry surfaces rendered into opaque, cutout, or blended scene passes.

capabilities.notes: Full surface lighting, cutout, alpha blend, and multi-pass outline execution.
Reduced light budget and disabled advanced PBR lobes.
C# native runtime covers core PBR/Unlit only; V2 models follow in native wave.

domains.label: Decal
domains.description: Overlay projection surfaces with depth-biased blending onto existing geometry.

capabilities.notes: Decal blending, angle fade, and depth bias execute via gltf/decal.
Minimal profile disables projected decal passes.
C# native runtime parity for V2 models is scheduled for a follow-up wave.

domains.label: Post-Process
domains.description: Screen-space full-frame compositing and color grading contract.

capabilities.notes: Color grading, tint, vignette, and blend factor execute via post-process/contract.
Reduced screen-space passes without depth-based masking.
C# native runtime parity for V2 models is scheduled for a follow-up wave.

domains.label: Volume
domains.description: Volumetric density raymarching with Beer-Lambert absorption and Henyey-Greenstein phase scattering.

capabilities.notes: Volumetric raymarch pass executes Beer-Lambert density and anisotropic scattering via gltf/volume.
Volumetric raymarching is unsupported on the minimal profile.
C# native runtime parity for V2 models is scheduled for a follow-up wave.

models.label: PBR
models.description: Model-driven physically based surface with ambient occlusion, opacity map, and advanced specular lobes.

outputSlots.label: Vertex Offset
outputSlots.description: Per-vertex object-space offset compiled into generated vertex shaders.

outputSlots.label: Ambient Occlusion
outputSlots.description: Scalar ambient occlusion factor plus _OcclusionTexture strength.

outputSlots.label: Opacity Map
outputSlots.description: Dedicated alpha/mask texture sampled via _OpacityTexture.

outputSlots.label: Depth Offset
outputSlots.description: Fragment depth bias applied in decal, water, and post-process paths.

capabilities.notes: Surface, AO, opacity map, and advanced lobes compile end-to-end; Vertex Offset runs in generated shaders.
Reduced light budget; clearcoat, sheen, anisotropy, subsurface, iridescence, and transmission are dropped.
Native consumes core PBR only; advanced V2 slots await native wave.
